salesiq_siqods_pp_agent_amt_smry.src_fltr_query: SELECT AGENT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, TRX_DATE, PAP_AMT, CHANNEL_CD FROM src_file_vw WHERE PAP_AMT IS NOT NULL AND PAP_AMT >= 0
salesiq_siqods_pp_agent_amt_smry.table_1: (SELECT PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_TYPE, PAP_WEIGHT_PCT, STATE_CD FROM {0}.PROD_HIER_DETL) ph
salesiq_siqods_pp_agent_amt_smry.lkp_query: select src.AGENT_ID, last_day(src.TRX_DATE) as REPORTING_MONTH, coalesce(am.OVERRIDE_CHANNEL, am.RECOGNIZED_CHANNEL) as EFFECTIVE_CHANNEL, sum(CASE WHEN ph.PRODUCT_TYPE in ('Life','MoneyGuard','Fixed Annuity') THEN src.PAP_AMT * (ph.PAP_WEIGHT_PCT/100.0) ELSE 0 END) as TOTAL_PAP_AMT, sum(CASE WHEN ph.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'Fixed Indexed Annuity' THEN src.PAP_AMT ELSE 0 END) as FIA_PAP_AMT, sum(CASE WHEN ph.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'Variable' OR ph.STATE_CD = 'NY' THEN src.PAP_AMT ELSE 0 END) as VARIABLE_NY_PAP_AMT from src_vw src left join table_1_vw ph on src.PRODUCT_ID = ph.PRODUCT_ID left join table_2_vw am on src.AGENT_ID = am.AGENT_ID group by src.AGENT_ID, last_day(src.TRX_DATE), coalesce(am.OVERRIDE_CHANNEL, am.RECOGNIZED_CHANNEL)
salesiq_siqods_pp_agent_amt_smry.rec_after_fltr: (select lkp.* from lkp_vw lkp left join curr_vw tgt on lkp.AGENT_ID = tgt.AGENT_ID AND lkp.REPORTING_MONTH = tgt.REPORTING_MONTH where tgt.pp_agent_amt_smry_id is null or tgt.total_pap_amt <> lkp.total_pap_amt)
salesiq_siqods_pp_agent_amt_smry.select_fields_query: SELECT agent_id, reporting_month, cast(total_pap_amt as decimal(15,2)) as total_pap_amt, cast(CASE WHEN effective_channel = 'Allstate' THEN total_pap_amt - fia_pap_amt ELSE total_pap_amt END as decimal(15,2)) as service_pap_amt, cast(CASE WHEN effective_channel = 'Allstate' THEN total_pap_amt - variable_ny_pap_amt - fia_pap_amt ELSE total_pap_amt - variable_ny_pap_amt END as decimal(15,2)) as financial_pap_amt, cast((CASE WHEN effective_channel = 'Allstate' THEN total_pap_amt - variable_ny_pap_amt - fia_pap_amt ELSE total_pap_amt - variable_ny_pap_amt END / month(reporting_month)) * 12 as decimal(15,2)) as projected_financial_pap_amt, cast({0} as decimal(19,0)) as BTCH_ID, current_date as CRTD_DT, null as MDFD_DT, '{1}-pp' as CRTD_BY, null as MDFD_BY FROM tgt_sink_df_vw

salesiq_siqods_pp_qualfctn_sumry.table_1: (SELECT AGENT_ID, coalesce(OVERRIDE_ROLE, RECOGNIZED_ROLE) as EFFECTIVE_ROLE FROM {0}.AGENT_MASTR) am
salesiq_siqods_pp_qualfctn_sumry.table_2: (SELECT AGENT_ID, QUAL_YEAR, QUALIFICATION_LEVEL, PINNACLE_STATUS_IND, SUSTAINING_STATUS_IND, LAST_QUALIFYING_YEAR FROM siqstg.stg_pp_historical_qual) hq
salesiq_siqods_pp_qualfctn_sumry.lkp_query: select src.AGENT_ID, src.REPORTING_MONTH, am.EFFECTIVE_ROLE, src.SERVICE_PAP_AMT, src.FINANCIAL_PAP_AMT, src.PROJECTED_FINANCIAL_PAP_AMT, CASE WHEN am.EFFECTIVE_ROLE = 'FP' AND src.FINANCIAL_PAP_AMT >= 600000 THEN 'Diamond' WHEN am.EFFECTIVE_ROLE = 'FP' AND src.FINANCIAL_PAP_AMT >= 225000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN am.EFFECTIVE_ROLE = 'FP' AND src.FINANCIAL_PAP_AMT >= 150000 THEN 'Gold' WHEN am.EFFECTIVE_ROLE = 'Agency/Manager' AND src.FINANCIAL_PAP_AMT >= 5000000 THEN 'Diamond' WHEN am.EFFECTIVE_ROLE = 'Agency/Manager' AND src.FINANCIAL_PAP_AMT >= 2500000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN am.EFFECTIVE_ROLE = 'Agency/Manager' AND src.FINANCIAL_PAP_AMT >= 1500000 THEN 'Gold' ELSE NULL END as QUALIFICATION_LEVEL, max(CASE WHEN hq.QUAL_YEAR = year(src.REPORTING_MONTH) - 1 AND hq.QUALIFICATION_LEVEL IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) as IS_PRIOR_YEAR_QUAL, max(CASE WHEN hq.QUAL_YEAR = year(src.REPORTING_MONTH) - 2 AND hq.QUALIFICATION_LEVEL IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) as IS_TWO_YR_ARREAR_QUAL, max(CASE WHEN hq.SUSTAINING_STATUS_IND = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) as SUSTAINING_STATUS_IND, max(CASE WHEN hq.SUSTAINING_STATUS_IND = 'Y' AND (year(src.REPORTING_MONTH) - hq.LAST_QUALIFYING_YEAR) <= 3 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) as SUSTAINING_SVC_BENEFIT_IND, max(CASE WHEN hq.PINNACLE_STATUS_IND = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) as PINNACLE_STATUS_IND, max(CASE WHEN hq.PINNACLE_STATUS_IND = 'Y' AND (year(src.REPORTING_MONTH) - hq.LAST_QUALIFYING_YEAR) <= 5 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) as PINNACLE_SVC_BENEFIT_IND, max(disc.NON_REGISTERED_IND) as NON_REGISTERED_IND from src_vw src left join table_1_vw am on src.AGENT_ID = am.AGENT_ID left join table_2_vw hq on src.AGENT_ID = hq.AGENT_ID left join table_3_vw disc on src.AGENT_ID = disc.AGENT_ID group by src.AGENT_ID, src.REPORTING_MONTH, am.EFFECTIVE_ROLE, src.SERVICE_PAP_AMT, src.FINANCIAL_PAP_AMT, src.PROJECTED_FINANCIAL_PAP_AMT
salesiq_siqods_pp_qualfctn_sumry.rec_after_fltr: (select lkp.* from lkp_vw lkp left join curr_vw tgt on lkp.AGENT_ID = tgt.AGENT_ID AND lkp.REPORTING_MONTH = tgt.REPORTING_MONTH where tgt.pp_qualfctn_sumry_id is null or tgt.qualification_level is distinct from lkp.QUALIFICATION_LEVEL) WHERE (QUALIFICATION_LEVEL IS NOT NULL OR IS_PRIOR_YEAR_QUAL='Y' OR IS_TWO_YR_ARREAR_QUAL='Y' OR SUSTAINING_SVC_BENEFIT_IND='Y' OR PINNACLE_SVC_BENEFIT_IND='Y' OR PROJECTED_FINANCIAL_PAP_AMT >= (CASE WHEN EFFECTIVE_ROLE='FP' THEN 150000*0.99 ELSE 1500000*0.99 END))
salesiq_siqods_pp_qualfctn_sumry.select_fields_query: SELECT agent_id, reporting_month, qualification_level, CASE WHEN qualification_level IS NOT NULL THEN 'CURRENT_YTD' WHEN is_prior_year_qual = 'Y' THEN 'PRIOR_YEAR' WHEN is_two_yr_arrear_qual = 'Y' THEN 'TWO_YR_ARREAR' WHEN sustaining_svc_benefit_ind = 'Y' THEN 'ACTIVE_SUSTAINING' WHEN pinnacle_svc_benefit_ind = 'Y' THEN 'ACTIVE_PINNACLE' ELSE 'PRODUCTION_PROXIMITY' END as inclusion_reason_cd, pinnacle_status_ind, pinnacle_svc_benefit_ind, sustaining_status_ind, sustaining_svc_benefit_ind, cast(projected_financial_pap_amt / (CASE WHEN qualification_level='Gold' AND effective_role='FP' THEN 225000 WHEN qualification_level IS NULL AND effective_role='FP' THEN 150000 WHEN qualification_level='Platinum' AND effective_role='FP' THEN 600000 WHEN qualification_level='Gold' AND effective_role='Agency/Manager' THEN 2500000 WHEN qualification_level IS NULL AND effective_role='Agency/Manager' THEN 1500000 WHEN qualification_level='Platinum' AND effective_role='Agency/Manager' THEN 5000000 ELSE NULL END) as decimal(5,2)) as production_proximity_pct, CASE WHEN non_registered_ind is not null and financial_pap_amt >= 150000 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END as deferred_comp_eligible_ind, cast({0} as decimal(19,0)) as BTCH_ID, current_date as CRTD_DT, null as MDFD_DT, '{1}-pp' as CRTD_BY, null as MDFD_BY FROM tgt_sink_df_vw

salesiq_siqods_fact_pp_qualfctn_sumry.tgt_cnt_query: (select count(1) from {0}.FACT_PP_QUALFCTN_SUMRY where btch_id={1} and crtd_by='{2}-pp') tgt
salesiq_siqods_fact_pp_qualfctn_sumry.src_fltr_query: SELECT AGENT_ID, REPORTING_MONTH, QUALIFICATION_LEVEL, PINNACLE_STATUS_IND, SUSTAINING_STATUS_IND FROM {0}.PP_QUALFCTN_SUMRY src_file_vw
salesiq_siqods_fact_pp_qualfctn_sumry.table_2: (SELECT AGENT_ID, coalesce(OVERRIDE_ROLE, RECOGNIZED_ROLE) as EFFECTIVE_ROLE, coalesce(OVERRIDE_CHANNEL, RECOGNIZED_CHANNEL) as EFFECTIVE_CHANNEL, ACCOUNT_ID FROM {0}.AGENT_MASTR) am
salesiq_siqods_fact_pp_qualfctn_sumry.lkp_query: select src.AGENT_ID, src.REPORTING_MONTH, year(src.REPORTING_MONTH) as REPORTING_YEAR, am.EFFECTIVE_ROLE as RECOGNIZED_ROLE, am.EFFECTIVE_CHANNEL as RECOGNIZED_CHANNEL, terr.TERRITORY_ID, src.QUALIFICATION_LEVEL, amt.TOTAL_PAP_AMT, src.PINNACLE_STATUS_IND, src.SUSTAINING_STATUS_IND, CASE WHEN src.QUALIFICATION_LEVEL='Gold' THEN 1.00 WHEN src.QUALIFICATION_LEVEL='Platinum' THEN 3.00 WHEN src.QUALIFICATION_LEVEL='Diamond' THEN 5.00 ELSE NULL END as IUL_BONUS_PCT, CASE WHEN am.EFFECTIVE_CHANNEL='Agency' AND am.EFFECTIVE_ROLE='FP' AND src.PINNACLE_STATUS_IND='Y' AND src.QUALIFICATION_LEVEL='Diamond' THEN 20000.00 WHEN am.EFFECTIVE_CHANNEL='Agency' AND am.EFFECTIVE_ROLE='FP' AND src.PINNACLE_STATUS_IND='Y' AND src.QUALIFICATION_LEVEL='Platinum' THEN 10000.00 ELSE NULL END as RSU_AMT, CASE WHEN src.QUALIFICATION_LEVEL='Gold' AND (src.PINNACLE_STATUS_IND='Y' OR src.SUSTAINING_STATUS_IND='Y') THEN 8000.00 WHEN src.QUALIFICATION_LEVEL='Gold' THEN 4000.00 WHEN src.QUALIFICATION_LEVEL='Platinum' AND (src.PINNACLE_STATUS_IND='Y' OR src.SUSTAINING_STATUS_IND='Y') THEN 16000.00 WHEN src.QUALIFICATION_LEVEL='Platinum' THEN 8000.00 WHEN src.QUALIFICATION_LEVEL='Diamond' AND (src.PINNACLE_STATUS_IND='Y' OR src.SUSTAINING_STATUS_IND='Y') THEN 24000.00 WHEN src.QUALIFICATION_LEVEL='Diamond' THEN 12000.00 ELSE NULL END as BUS_DEV_DOLLARS_AMT, current_timestamp as LOAD_DT from src_vw src left join table_1_vw amt on src.AGENT_ID = amt.AGENT_ID left join table_2_vw am on src.AGENT_ID = am.AGENT_ID left join table_3_vw terr on am.ACCOUNT_ID = terr.ACCOUNT_ID cross join table_4_vw lastload
salesiq_siqods_fact_pp_qualfctn_sumry.rec_after_fltr: (select lkp.* from lkp_vw lkp left join curr_vw tgt on lkp.AGENT_ID = tgt.AGENT_ID AND lkp.REPORTING_MONTH = tgt.REPORTING_MONTH AND lkp.LOAD_DT = tgt.LOAD_DT where tgt.fact_pp_qualfctn_sumry_id is null)
salesiq_siqods_fact_pp_qualfctn_sumry.select_fields_query: SELECT agent_id, reporting_month, reporting_year, recognized_role, recognized_channel, territory_id, qualification_level, cast(total_pap_amt as decimal(15,2)) as total_pap_amt, cast(iul_bonus_pct as decimal(5,2)) as iul_bonus_pct, cast(rsu_amt as decimal(10,2)) as rsu_amt, cast(bus_dev_dollars_amt as decimal(10,2)) as bus_dev_dollars_amt, load_dt, cast({0} as decimal(19,0)) as BTCH_ID, current_date as CRTD_DT, null as MDFD_DT, '{1}-pp' as CRTD_BY, null as MDFD_BY FROM tgt_sink_df_vw
salesiq_siqods_fact_pp_qualfctn_sumry.dedup_note: Merge/dedup key is AGENT_ID + REPORTING_MONTH + LOAD_DT. Do not overwrite or delete prior REPORTING_MONTH rows; multiple LOAD_DT batches for the same AGENT_ID+REPORTING_MONTH are expected and must be retained.
